rob_ae: FYI Harbor Capital sent a procurement/security checklist. Key asks: SAML SSO, SCIM (delta), RBAC group->role mapping, domain lock (2 domains), 12mo audit logs, and CMK for at-rest keys. They want a 2-week POC estimate and production pricing for Dedicated (4 GPUs).

maria_se: Understood. Do they need inbound group sync (AD) or just user push?

rob_ae: They need inbound groups + nested group mapping. Quote: 'must map nested AD groups to roles and deny access for unverified domains.'

ash_compliance: Notes: Hosted offers 90d logs; we can enable enterprise retention trial to 13 months for POC. CMK only on Dedicated/Private; Hosted uses provider KMS envelope encryption. We'll prepare a 1-page controls summary (SOC2, TLS1.2+, KMS options, log export S3).

leo_csm: POC goals: validate SAML assertion mapping, SCIM delta with 10 users and 3 nested groups, RBAC enforcement for model access, and log export to their S3.

maria_se: Tech: SCIM v2 delta supported, mapping rules can flatten nested groups. Model ACLs exist; we can demo deny-lists for sensitive models.

infra_bot: config:harbor-poc uploaded -> https://redwood.internal/configs/harbor-poc (internal).

rob_ae: Action items: 1) Send SAML attr mapping template + SCIM samples (maria) 2) Offer 2-week hosted POC with enterprise retention trial pending NDA 3) Provide Dedicated and Private ballpark pricing (finance) 4) Ash to draft security cover note.

ash_compliance: Will send controls summary and sample ATO language by EOD.

maria_se: Can demo tomorrow 9am PT for SAML+SCIM+RBAC.

rob_ae: I'll request IdP metadata and domain verification from Harbor and ask them to sign NDA to unlock credits. :thumbsup:
